case_title: Hold for one parcel versus split shipment today
exception_description: Order SH-9017 contains two items from different zones. One item is ready now; the second is expected at the pick face later today. AI recommends holding both items and shipping together in one parcel.
layer1_visible: Order SH-9017 contains two items from different zones. One item is ready now; the second is expected at the pick face later today. AI recommends holding both items and shipping together in one parcel.
detail_expand: Sending a split shipment would improve perceived speed for one line item, but it doubles parcel and packing cost. The customer selected standard delivery, and the second item is still expected before pack cutoff. The case is built to test whether participants over-intervene on moderate ambiguity when a combined shipment remains the best total-cost choice.
ai_recommendation: AI recommends holding and shipping together because the second item is still expected before cutoff and one parcel avoids duplicate fulfillment cost.

decision_options.action_label: Pause to confirm ETA and customer preference
Ship ready item now and split the order

traceability_text.trace_rationale_short: One parcel is cheaper if the second item still arrives before the day-end cutoff.

traceability_text.recommended_check: Check the inbound ETA and any delivery-preference note before releasing.

feedback_text.feedback_ai_outcome: The second item arrived in time, so the combined shipment was the lowest-cost acceptable choice.
feedback_text.feedback_alt1_outcome: The ETA check confirmed the same answer, but the pause consumed time without changing the best action.
feedback_text.feedback_alt2_outcome: The split shipment improved speed for one item, but the duplicated parcel work made it more expensive overall.
